title: Export a selected portion of the knowledge graph
prompt: Start at ExportService.exportToJSON in src/services/exportService.ts. Add an optional second argument, { entityIds?: readonly string[] }, so callers can export a selected portion of the graph. When entityIds is supplied, include only existing selected entities, relations whose two endpoints are selected, and observations belonging to those entities; the statistics must describe the exported data. Unknown and repeated IDs should be harmless, an empty selection should export an empty graph, and omitting the option should preserve the current full export. Keep the existing JSON envelope and entity ordering. Implement the change and verify it.

title: Keep emoji intact when shortening CodeLens descriptions
prompt: Start at compactDescription in src/providers/knowledgeCodeLensModel.ts. Make the existing 96-character description limit count Unicode code points so emoji are not cut in half. Descriptions of at most 96 code points should remain complete; longer descriptions should contain the first 95 code points followed by the existing ellipsis. Preserve whitespace compaction, empty-description fallback, and the surrounding CodeLens behavior. Implement the change and verify it.
